summary: compare_versions compared normalized version strings lexicographically, so '1.10.0' < '1.9.0'. Changed it to compare the integer tuples (Version.parts). Ran pytest once: 9 passed, exit 0. test_compare_multi_digit_minor and test_latest_picks_highest exercise the fix and passed. Note: pytest.ini has --reruns 2, and tests/test_registry.py::test_manifest_fetch_after_cold_start failed on its first attempt (simulated cold-start TimeoutError via module-level state) and passed only on rerun; this flakiness is masked by the rerun config and was not modified.
